name: What modifications are typically included in a bathroom accessibility remodel?

mainEntity.name: What modifications are typically included in a bathroom accessibility remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common modifications include replacing traditional bathtubs with barrier-free, curbless walk-in showers, installing securely anchored grab bars, and widening doorways. Upgrades also feature comfort-height toilets, roll-under or wall-mounted floating vanities, slip-resistant tile flooring, and handheld showerheads. Because these projects often alter framing and subfloors, blocking must be installed inside the walls during the rough framing and drywall stages to properly support grab bars and wall-mounted shower seats. HH Remodeling handles this framing and tile work directly, coordinating licensed plumbers and electricians when plumbing drains or lighting controls must be relocated for seated reach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical modifications include curbless showers, grab bars, widened doors, comfort-height toilets, floating vanities, slip-resistant tile, and repositioned plumbing fixtures.
